subject: Provisioning ladder & vendor commit cadence for ACME expansion (deal-4521)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Cho <sara@acmeai.com>, procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning ladder & vendor commit cadence for ACME expansion (deal-4521)

Hi Sara / Nimbus team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. As AcmeAI moves from POC to a committed Dedicated capacity commitment under DEAL-4521, we need tight alignment on a few lead-time items so we can size the staging pool and schedule cloud backfill. High-level asks below — aim to get responses by EOD Friday so we can finalise the MAP and send to finance.

1) Vendor commit windows: can Nimbus provide firm ship-by and allocation dates for an initial tranche of 40x A100-class GPUs and a contingent tranche of +60 units within the next 12 weeks? If not firm, please provide the earliest realistic week and any constraints.
2) OEM lead times: do you have an OEM quote or allocation hold we can rely on? If Intel/other OEMs have partial allocations, we need the ETA and whether it’s a firm reservation (paid/freight terms).
3) Cloud backstop: we plan to hold 20% of initial capacity in cloud (multi-region) for the first 8 weeks. Any surge costs or minimums we should budget?
4) Attachments: I will attach a provisioning ladder CSV with proposed tranche dates and expected SLO for onboarding. Please validate.

Marissa/Ben/Neha — please call out constraints from deployment, PM, and sales perspective respectively.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Dedicated Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisioning_ladder_v1.csv (proposed tranches: 2027-09-01 40 units; 2027-10-15 60 units contingency)
From: NimbusCloud Procurement <procurement@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning ladder & vendor commit cadence for ACME expansion (deal-4521)

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick summary from our side after checking allocation queues:

- Initial tranche (40x A100-equivalent): earliest ship week we can commit to is 2027-09-06. This is contingent on a 30% deposit and signed PO by 2027-08-10.
- Contingent tranche (+60 units): current estimate is available late Oct / early Nov. ETA range 2027-10-25 to 2027-11-10; not firm until payment & Q-commit window.
- OEM holds: several of these chassis are on allocation with OEM partners. We can provide an OEM lead time sheet — attaching Nimbus_Quote_Q3_v2.pdf and OEM_leadtime_sheet.xlsx.
- Cloud backstop: we can provide short-term reserved cloud capacity in us-west and us-east for up to 12 weeks. Cost uplift ~18% over on-demand list for the guaranteed window; hourly minimum applies.

I attached the quote and the OEM lead time sheet. Please review and let us know if you need us to push for improved ETA (we can escalate but it requires an allocation fee).

Best,
Alex Marin
Procurement Lead
NimbusCloud Solutions

Attachments: Nimbus_Quote_Q3_v2.pdf, OEM_leadtime_sheet.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning ladder & vendor commit cadence for ACME expansion (deal-4521)

Karthik / team —

Thanks, Alex — the documents look reasonable. A few operational notes from staging and onboarding:

- We need a two-week hardware validation window after delivery before we flip traffic. That pushes first-live date to ~2027-09-20 if ship is 2027-09-06.
- Can we carve a warm-standby pool in the cloud for the first 6 weeks to absorb onboarding variance? Ben, please confirm cost sensitivity.
- If Nimbus requires a 30% deposit for the initial tranche, finance will want an amended PO and the MAP that ties milestones to payment tranches (delivery acceptance, perf validation, SLA sign-off).

Neha, Ben — call out if any deal-level concessions (credits / onboarding assistance) are needed to keep Acme within our Target ACV.

— Marissa
Director, Dedicated Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sen <priya.sen@intel.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning ladder & vendor commit cadence for ACME expansion (deal-4521)

Hi Karthik / Alex / Marissa —

I’m looping in OEM allocation details per your request. Short summary:

- We have a partial allocation that can reserve 30 chassis on a 60-day hold with confirmed PO and partial payment (30%). ETA for shipping those 30 units is 2027-09-08 — aligns with Nimbus’s earliest ship week.
- Remaining capacity will move to a best-effort queue; current estimated availability mid-Oct but not firm.
- Lead time sheet attached with SKU-level ETA and freight assumptions. Note that any custom cooling orders or specific rack configs add 3-4 weeks.

If Redwood can confirm PO + allocation fee by 2027-08-10, we will lock the 30-chassis reservation. Happy to discuss allocation fee waivers if this is part of a larger multi-deal commit.

Best,
Priya Sen
OEM Channel Sales
Intel Corp.

Attachment: OEM_leadtime_sheet.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Cho <sara@acmeai.com>, procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning ladder & vendor commit cadence for ACME expansion (deal-4521)

Folks —

Thanks for the quick turn. Proposed mutual action plan based on the inputs:

- 2027-08-06: Redwood to share final MAP and amended PO (we will include milestone language tied to acceptance testing).
- 2027-08-10: Deposit (30%) to Nimbus to secure initial tranche and trigger OEM hold for 30 chassis via Intel.
- 2027-09-06: Nimbus ships initial 40 units to our staging site (per their quote).
- 2027-09-20: After 2-week validation, we flip first tranche live with 20% cloud backstop active for 8 weeks.
- Contingency: If OEM final availability slips beyond 2027-10-25, we will evaluate cloud extension or temporary borrow from our existing reserved pool (Ben to advise).

Attachments: I am attaching a cleaned provisioning_ladder_v1.csv and a proposed payment milestone sketch (please see attachments). Alex — please confirm whether the 30% payment deadline and allocation hold process are acceptable. Priya — thanks for the allocation offer; we will confirm PO by 2027-08-10 if finance approves.

Sara — I’ll include the MAP in the next note to AcmeAI that formalises timelines. If Acme needs faster start dates, let us know what they can commit to on deposit / escalation fees — that will help push OEM/Q-commit.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Dedicated Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisioning_ladder_v1.csv, Nimbus_Quote_Q3_v2.pdf
